mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(MAX(v.boundary),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'NONE') FROM ( SELECT valid_from AS boundary FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_to AS boundary FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_to <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_from AS boundary FROM rights_revision r WHERE valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_to AS boundary FROM rights_revision r WHERE valid_to <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) v
SELECT document_revision FROM artifact a WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND artifact_id=#{artifactId} AND artifact_kind='SELECTION' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotation a WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} AND status=#{status}
mapper.sql: a.tenant_id,a.project_id,a.annotation_id,a.document_revision,a.node_id,a.selection,a.selection_artifact_id, a.quoted_sha256,a.status,a.content,a.actor_id,a.schema_version,a.schema_manifest_sha256,a.created_by,a.created_at, a.classification,a.revision,a.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotation_reply r WHERE r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.project_id=a.project_id AND r.annotation_id=a.annotation_id) AS reply_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM annotation a WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.document_revision=#{documentRevision} AND a.annotation_id=#{annotationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM annotation a WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.annotation_id=#{annotationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.tenant_id,a.project_id,a.annotation_id,k.document_revision,k.node_id,k.selection,k.selection_artifact_id, k.selection_sha256 AS quoted_sha256,a.status,a.content,a.actor_id,a.schema_version,a.schema_manifest_sha256,a.created_by,a.created_at, a.classification,a.revision,a.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotation_reply r WHERE r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.project_id=a.project_id AND r.annotation_id=a.annotation_id) AS reply_count FROM annotation a JOIN annotation_effective_anchor e ON e.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND e.project_id=a.project_id AND e.annotation_id=a.annotation_id JOIN annotation_anchor k ON k.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND k.project_id=e.project_id AND k.annotation_id=e.annotation_id AND k.anchor_id=e.anchor_id WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.annotation_id=#{annotationId} AND k.document_revision=#{documentRevision} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId,r.document_revision AS documentRevision,r.decision,r.target_key AS targetKey FROM review_decision r WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.document_revision=#{documentRevision} AND r.decision='CONFIRM' AND r.target_key='DOCUMENT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_invalidation i WHERE i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.project_id=r.project_id AND i.review_id=r.review_id) ORDER BY r.review_id LIMIT #{reviewLimit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,operation_id,subject_id,operation_name,idempotency_key,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref, target_id,error_code,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at, dedup_expires_at,dedup_policy_revision FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='RV-04-THREAD-1' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE aggregate_id=#{annotationId} AND aggregate_revision='1' AND event_type='annotation.created'
